data.description:
Nümmerzwei is a tall and muscular black anthropomorphic wolf (2m08 tall) and a Henker, the secret anthro assassins of Humanny. Nümmerzwei's real name (such as the one of Nümmerdrei) is actually unknown, it is uncertain they have a name of their own to begin with. 'Nümmerzwei' is technically a code name at first.

Appearance: Nümmerzwei has a dark black fur. He always wears his dog tags collection with him. He wears a black, leather, long trenchcoat, generally with nothing under when he's not on shift. Regardlesd, he is very often topless under his trenchcoat, as so people can see a glimpse of his astounding natural musculature that would make envy a lot of males. During his shift he wears large black work trousers with a leather belt. He never wears shoes or socks, as he finds them subpar. He has brown-orange eyes, and a scar on the right side of the snout, caused by Victoria Cannisky, Elizabeth Cannisky's mother.

Sociopathic but silly anthro. Does the mission no more and no less. He is currently Ken Bahrbahr's private guard, but actually acts on Wüstenfuchs orders as Wüstenfuchs managed to convince him that his plan was better than Ken's one.

He is more dangerous during leisure time than during mission time, as he gets a lot more loose during leisure time, allowing himself to do any kind of excess possibly possible, even criminal ones.

He is actually a sex offender and likes to rape overall, be it people, anthros or anything he could reasonably fuck. Contrary to Wüstenfuchs, he always let live the ones he raped (except in the case in which the being wouldn't survive the humping). He also actually listens to some extent his victims desires or reactions, but doesn't always take notice of these. He is proud of his male attribute 'alpha daddy' making an impressive 27 centimeters long, a quite rare sight among canine anthros, generally having only 2-5 centimeters more in average when compared to human males.

Trophy hunter: He collects the dogtags of the enemies he killed as trophies. He is proud of his collection.

Obsession with Elizabeth Cannisky: Nümmerzwei killed Elizabeth's parents as a side contract killing. Elizabeth's father, Igor Cannisky, was a Furrench spy. He killed both Igor and Victoria, along as their unborn hybrid fairly easily, although he was injured fairly seriously by Victoria; Nümmerzwei kept several scars of the fight; but he failed at killing their young hybrid daughter, Elizabeth Cannisky. Given Elizabeth became a famous hacktivist and cyberterrorist during the war, he feels sorry to have inadvertantly created a serious national security threat by making the hybrid anthro wolfess an orphan. Since he had several encounters with Elizabeth but always failed to kill her, as he has always been outsmarted in a way or another and she escaped, regardless of the weapons he was using, or the field layout and his relative stealth. As a result he is very determined to kill her and reduce her corpse in small pieces. He is not cannibalistic, but given viewed Wüstenfuchs 'gaining' power (actually a placebo effect) from eating his victims; Nümmerzwei might decide to make Elizabeth his first anthro meat meal, should he finally manage to kill her. Their both fates seems strangely entwined in a twisted way, analog to a long hunter and prey game.

Weapons of choice:
To protect Ken Bahbahr, he uses a Claridge Hi-Tec S9 machine pistol, it has a barrel shroud to allow use with both hands. It is also his weapon of choice against humans.
Against anthros, he uses an Automag 3 Longslide handgun in dot 30 caliber, it is not lethal against anthros, but very accurate, it has a Surefire red laser sight fitted on top, giving the gun a retrofuturistic look.
As a last resort, he holds a blowpipe loaded with darts containing a strong secret hallucinogenic poison made originally by and for the NSA.
His sister, Nümmerdrei, has a copy of all these weapons as well except for the blowpipe. They both like to have matching pair guns when they 'hunt' together.
